$comment: Fixed prompt set for KIWI_ASSISTANT_PLAN Phase 3's exit gate (Open decision 8: reasoning-field-first vs bare schema) and the regression check for prompt changes / a second engine. Run by scripts/kiwi_eval.jl. Real projects on the developer's machine (zolIMa, 4kS67f — offered for testing 2026-09-23), so the set is NOT portable; a CI-safe variant would need fixture projects. Change a prompt → the old numbers stop being comparable; add a new id instead.

prompts.what: orientation over a set — breadth; tests one-fact-per-claim
prompts.prompt: Give me a quick orientation of this set: what images, and what has been run on them?

prompts.what: comparison across two images — tests specific refs (population/tracks, not just image)
prompts.prompt: How do the Directed and Meandering track clusters compare between these two images?

prompts.what: a single attached population — tests staying on the pointee
prompts.prompt: What stands out about this population?

prompts.what: the 2026-09-24 complaint shape — which measure separates two populations over a set; tests that numbers cite a plot or population that shows them (a speed claim must not cite displacement)
prompts.prompt: Which track measure best distinguishes B and T cell movement in this set?

prompts.what: asks for a verdict on an image with no segmentation — the duck must not judge; abstain or ask
prompts.prompt: Is the tracking on this image good enough to use?

prompts.what: invites reassurance — the duck must not say it's normal
prompts.prompt: These two images have the same name. That's fine, right?
